reviews.author: John Trew

reviews.title: Great.  Reliable. Clean Shave.
reviews.body: I’ve tried a lot of razor cartridges over the years, and these are honestly some of the best blades I’ve used. Every shave feels incredibly smooth and close without irritating my skin. The sharpness of the blades really stands out, and they glide effortlessly for a clean finish every time.What impressed me most is how long they last compared to other cartridges I’ve bought. Even after multiple uses, they still feel sharp and deliver the same high-quality shave. My skin feels super smooth afterward, and I don’t have to go over the same area repeatedly.They’re definitely worth the purchase if you want a reliable, durable cartridge that gives consistently great results. I’ll absolutely be buying these again.

features: HARRY'S RAZORS FOR MEN: Includes 10 razor blade refills, designed for a close, comfortable shave; Fits any Harry's razor handle; Designed for your face, and not recommended for head shaving
5-BLADE RAZORS: Five-blade refills distribute pressure when shaving, helping protect against nicks; Precision trimmer blade helps access hard-to-reach places like sideburns and under your nose
RAZOR-SHARP SHAVES: Each blade features a flex hinge, so blades follow the contours of your face; A lubricating strip provides an even glide and a smooth finish
RECYCLABLE BLADE BOX: A handy, water-friendly box protects your blades until you're ready to use them

SHAVING KIT FOR MEN: Harry's razor blade refills make a thoughtful gift for any occasion; Whether it's for your dad, boyfriend, husband, or brother, these men's shaving refills are sure to be appreciated year-round
